name: BEAT
summary: 语音和文本对齐的三维身体、手势与面部表情序列，包含情绪和语义相关性标注。
summaryEn: Speech/text-aligned 3D body, gesture, and facial-expression sequences with emotion and semantic-relevance annotations.
scale: 76 hours from 30 speakers; body and facial motion
scaleZh: 30 名说话者、76 小时身体及面部运动
organizations: University of Tokyo, Keio University, Huawei and JAIST
organizationsZh: 东京大学、庆应义塾大学、华为及北陆先端科学技术大学院大学
licenseZh: 非商业条款；需核查所用版本协议
access: Official project and dataset release repository
accessZh: 官方项目及数据发布仓库
verdict: 语音条件身体与表情演化
wmNote: 同步动作与音频可训练条件姿态生成；语音是上下文条件，不是物理控制输入。
wmNoteEn: Aligned motion/audio support conditional pose generation; speech is contextual conditioning, not physical control.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2203.05297] BEAT: A Large-Scale Semantic and Emotional Multi-Modal Dataset for Conversational Gestures Synthesis
evidence.statement: Conversational motion capture is time-aligned with audio and frame-level semantic/emotional annotations; human motion, not robot action commands.
